text: Sanding and sawing are important steps in carpentry. First, sanding is needed to smooth out rough edges and remove any splinters. This can be done by using a sandpaper or power sander. Once the surface is smooth, sawing is necessary to cut the wood to the desired length or shape. A variety of saws can be used, including saws for cutting wood, power saws, and even circular saws. With these two steps, carpenters can create sturdy and beautiful objects out of wood.
